column1: # tcgcsv group (set) -> official set code and how its Number column reads.
# Hand-kept and small. A group that is not listed here is matched by its
# abbreviation against the official set codes; a group matched by neither
# raises an `unmapped_group` alarm rather than being skipped.
#   main         Number is the set's collector number; the (Hyperspace) and
#   weekly_play  Number is "N/total" within the promo group; official serials
#                SS60NNN (Weekly Play) and SS35NNN (Weekly Play Foil); its
#                (Hyperspace) products are the Hyperspace printings SS02NNN
#   hyperspace_only  a group shared by many sets: only (Hyperspace) products
#   promo        prize and event printings, matched on name; the parenthetical
#                (Top 8, Finalist, ...) names the finish. `set` is * (any), the
#                last column lists the official variants the group carries.

column4: SS Participation|SS Top 8|SS Top 4|SS Finalist|SS Champion
